svg.text: Promotions Service (National & Venue Discounts · Ticketing Integration)
resolves venue FK for VENUE scope
1. NATIONAL valid everywhere; VENUE only at matching venue
2. VENUE scope requires venueId at creation (else error)
3. Validate: active · within validFrom–validUntil · currentUses < maxUses
4. Code uppercased on create and on lookup
5. Redeem is atomic — conditional UPDATE (no oversell)
6. Discount: percentage → % of total; flat capped at total
7. BuyTicket applies discount then redeems once
used inline in BuyTicket — not wired
